method: L=0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B. Flat bright = L>215 and 5x5 sigma<2.5. insidePct counts those pixels whose camera ray hits y=0 with |x|<=24 and |z|<=24, as a percent of the frame. Sela is the 17x17 patch around the projection of (x,0.9,z). pip is a rim-colored count in the outer 70px (r 220-252, g 160-210, b 50-110).
